note: Synthetic prescription dictation for S6, in the doctor's consultation voice.
text: Paracetamol, two tablets, four times a day, for five days. Benzydamine gargle, 15 mL, three times a day, for five days.
say: Paracetamol, two tablets, four times a day, for five days. Benzydamine gargle, fifteen M L, three times a day, for five days.
parser_note: Checked against backend/src/medications parseSig: "two tablets" and "15 mL" give doses; spelled-out "milligrams", "gram" and "millilitres" do not. If Soniox writes "fifteen ML", line 2 loses its dose: re-check after the check run.
